hero.description: Start with authentic user reviews and preserve a complete evidence chain from feedback and findings to product requirements and test validation.

failed.title: Backend Disconnected
failed.description: Unable to reach {{apiBaseUrl}}. Confirm that the backend service is running.

page.title: New Analysis
page.description: Import authentic or supplied user reviews and run deterministic validation, normalization, cleaning, and deduplication before semantic analysis begins.
page.scopeDescription: This phase processes review data only. It does not run topic discovery, generate findings, or call an LLM.

form.title: Analysis input
form.description: Choose one data source and optionally describe what this analysis should focus on.
form.uploadHint: UTF-8 and UTF-8 BOM are supported. Maximum 10 MiB and 10,000 records.
form.goalPlaceholder: For example: Focus on subscription conversion, low ratings, and recent-version usability.
